message: Live Windows 2.2.11 evidence: pending turn 39 still cannot reach GPT. After restart, every control poll logs CONTROL: page=new followed by diag=zero_messages, messages=0, composer=0; this repeats indefinitely. Therefore no equivalent/proven control page exists after service-Chrome restart, and navigating a new page to the saved alias https://chatgpt.com/c/WEB:<uuid> does not restore the conversation; the page evidently leaves the conversation URL and is excluded on the next poll, causing another new page. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.12 in agent-handoff only. Requirements: (1) add deterministic restore URL candidates for a saved control conversation: when identity is WEB:<uuid>, derive canonical https://chatgpt.com/c/<uuid> and try that canonical candidate before the saved WEB alias; normal non-WEB URLs keep their normal form. (2) A restore attempt must use one dedicated page and bounded waits; after each candidate goto, inspect the observed page.url, messages and composer. If the observed URL has the same conversation identity or positive control identity is visible, accept it and atomically canonicalize chatgpt_control_url to the observed URL, preserving bootstrap_sent_at/recovery_used/recovery metadata. (3) Do not create a fresh page on every poll. Reuse an existing restore-attempt page when possible and/or persist a bounded restore-attempt latch/cooldown. Failed restore candidates must not cause unbounded tab growth. (4) Never navigate an unrelated existing ChatGPT conversation. (5) Never resend bootstrap and never reset recovery_used. (6) Once the recovered conversation is usable, pending turn 39 must send exactly one wake under existing de-duplication. (7) Add pure tests for WEB alias -> canonical restore candidate ordering, successful canonical restore/canonicalization, both candidates failing without repeated page creation, non-WEB behavior, and metadata preservation. Preserve 2.2.10 raw->api GitHub failover, CHECK_INTERVAL and text-free logs. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Do not enable Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit write turn_id=41 target=GPT with SHA, changed files, exact tests, and restore semantics.
